skill.description: 当用户需要做今日头条内容研究、文章选题、热点角度整理或同主题内容对比时使用。输入主题或内容链接，基于相关作品和详情输出样本概览、标题模式与可继续验证的内容方向。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Research Toutiao topics, compare article samples, and identify content angles through SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static flags identify Markdown, readable Chinese prose, service links, and documented authentication rather than malicious behavior. The command examples automatically execute an unpinned npm package, creating a supply chain risk with access to the configured API credential. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or destructive instructions in the reviewed files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Command examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx without a fixed, reviewed version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lockfile integrity, then require explicit approval before downloading and executing dependencies with API credentials available.

content.user_title: Research Toutiao Topics and Article Patterns
content.value_statement: Toutiao topic research requires checking rankings, article samples, and source details together. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and turns returned evidence into content angles.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve Toutiao hot-search rankings and available popularity signals through SocialDataX.
Search topic keywords with page limits, item limits, and continuation tokens.
Retrieve article details by content ID, URL, or supported share text.
Compare representative samples for recurring angles and headline patterns.
Produce source-linked observations with sample scope, observation time, and missing information.
Guide recovery from partial results while preserving cumulative retrieval limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, sufficient account balance, and either a compatible CLI environment or configured MCP tools.
Returned fields and article text depend on service availability; missing content cannot support detailed conclusions.
Small samples and current rankings cannot establish long-term trends or complete platform coverage.
The skill provides retrieval instructions, not bundled CLI implementation; it does not log in, publish, or modify Toutiao accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan an Editorial Shortlist
use_cases.description: Review one page of topic samples and inspect representative articles before proposing evidence-based editorial angles.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand-Related Coverage
use_cases.description: Compare headlines, authors, and available engagement signals across articles about a brand or product category.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Current Topic
use_cases.description: Separate hot-search signals from keyword samples and document what the available evidence supports.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] on Toutiao using one search page. Summarize relevant samples and retain their links or content IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve details for [Toutiao URL or content ID]. Summarize available text, author, publication time, and engagement indicators. Mark missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Content Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [topic] and inspect three representative articles. Compare headline patterns and recurring angles. Cite each sample and distinguish observations from proposed angles.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Scoped Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] with at most [pages] pages and [items] items. Separate hot-search signals from keyword samples. Document missing data and evidence for each angle. Resume partial results only with valid continuation tokens and remaining limits.

output_examples.input: Compare headline patterns for electric vehicle charging using one search page.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are represented.
Scope: One keyword search page, with returned links or content IDs retained for each sample.
Headline patterns: Summarize repeated structures only when supported by retrieved titles.
Next step: Inspect up to three representative articles before recommending content angles.

output_examples.input: Inspect a supplied Toutiao article when its body is unavailable.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are represented.
Article body: Unavailable in the returned data.
Available evidence: List only returned title, author, publication time, and engagement fields.
Assessment: The title alone cannot establish the article's detailed claims.

best_practices: Start with one page and inspect one to three representative articles before expanding the sample.
Retain source links or content IDs and state observation time, sample limits, and missing fields.
Approve and review the CLI dependency before execution; keep the API key in the environment rather than prompts or reports.
anti_patterns: Claiming platform-wide coverage or long-term trends from a single page or current ranking.
Inventing article content from headlines when the body is missing.
Restarting partial searches from the first page or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a topic keyword, a request for current hot searches, a Toutiao content ID, or a content URL or supported share text.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient provider balance. The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and authorization to execute dependencies.

faq.question: Does this skill publish or change accounts?
faq.answer: The documented operations retrieve data only. No login, posting, liking, commenting, browser data access, or account modification is specified.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of shell commands?
faq.answer: The skill lists corresponding MCP tools for hot searches, keyword searches, and article details. Those tools must already be available and configured.

faq.question: Can the results establish a lasting trend?
faq.answer: No. Rankings and limited samples support scoped observations, not long-term trends or complete platform coverage.

faq.question: What happens when results are incomplete?
faq.answer: Preserve retrieved items and errors. Resume only with a nonempty continuation token and remaining limits. Stop repeated retries when balance is insufficient.
